issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run logs COMException 0x8004B207 during PNG thumbnail generation while large files transfer.
known_information: The report is from PowerToys 0.96.1 and reproduces during multi-gigabyte file transfers.
A follow-up distinguishes a thumbnail-provider HRESULT from a later UI-thread NullReferenceException.
inferences: The provider HRESULT may be an unavailable-thumbnail result while the later null dereference may be actionable; the two should not be conflated.
issue_context.analysis: The follow-up already refined the evidence. Leave the issue with its owner to separate provider failures from the later UI-thread exception; do not ask for generic logs already represented in the thread.
initial_investigation: The report links thumbnail generation to large file transfers; the latest comment distinguishes WTS_E_NOSTORAGEPROVIDERTHUMBNAILHANDLER from a later NullReferenceException.
